custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin who can switch between two locations: the test location and location B.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test at the test location only.
  • Create a part, part B, for this test at location B only, with its part number in capital letters, so it is a separate Part Library entry the test location does not stock.
  • Start on the Part Library page (Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu).

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Location B is Staging Lethbridge - 4310. To switch: click the box at the top right, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Lethbridge - 4310. Switch back to Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 the same way.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425612-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425612-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A's entry is listed.

Step 2:

  • The entry's detail page opens.

Step 3:

  • The "Edit Library Part" window opens.

Step 4:

  • Part Number shows part B's number.

Step 5:

  • The save is refused and the window stays open.
  • A red message reads "Part number" followed by part B's number and "already belongs to another part in the Part Library.", with a smaller second line "Please try to resolve this."

Step 6:

  • The red message has closed on its own after about 3 seconds, and the window is still open.

Step 7:

  • Part Number shows part B's number in small letters.

Step 8:

  • The save goes through, because the number differs from part B's in upper and lower case: the detail page shows the small-letter number exactly as typed.

Step 9:

  • The Parts left menu shows Part Library.

Step 10:

  • The Part Library page opens.

Step 11:

  • Two entries are listed: part B's (stocked at location B), still in capital letters with its own description, and the renamed one in small letters with part A's description. The two were not merged.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only), story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog), story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library)

  • S11-R3a: “Changing an entry's number or description on its detail page follows the part dialog's rules: S13-R12 to S13-R19, S13-N1, S13-N7, and S10-R23 to S10-R25.”
  • S13-N1: “If another Part Library entry already has exactly the typed number, with the same characters and the same upper and lower case, the save is refused, the dialog stays open, and the system shows "Part number {number} already belongs to another part in the Part Library."”
  • Key Decisions: “A rename follows the same match rule as linking. A rename is refused only when another Part Library entry has exactly the typed number: the same characters, with the same upper and lower case.”
  • Story 13, context note: “Context note: every refusal sent by the system, the rows that fade after 3 seconds, also shows a second, smaller line under the message: "Please try to resolve this." Messages the screen builds itself carry their own second line, as listed, or none.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Part number already belongs to another entry | "Part number {number} already belongs to another part in the Part Library." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds; the dialog stays open”
  • S12-R3: “The dialog for editing a Part Library entry is titled "Edit Library Part".”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
